From: Jen Park <jen.park@acerohealth.com>

Cc: Procurement <procurement@acerohealth.com>
Date: Fri, 14 Sep 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: availability exhibit + order-form language for MSA/SOW attachments

Hi Vivek,

Thanks for taking this. As part of our upcoming MSA/SOW we need a tailored availability exhibit and specific order-form language for Acero Health. Procurement asked me to confirm a few things before we circulate redlines:

- Target SLOs: 99.95% uptime (global) and 95th-percentile token latency of <=120ms for US-east. Can Redwood provide a proposal or exceptions path if regional variability is needed?
- Regional fallback: We want a clause describing how Redwood will route to a fallback region if regional capacity is degraded.
- Evidence: Procurement needs an evidence package (SOC2 scope references, historical monthly uptime report, and the technical runbook excerpts you can share).
- Order-form language: We expect a short exhibit that can be attached to the order form (not the MSA body) with credits/remedy schedule and how credits are calculated.

Can you send a draft exhibit and the minimal evidence items you can attach to the SOW? Timeline: procurement is hoping to complete redlines by next Wednesday (9/20). If you need more time, let me know.

Attachments we can share from our side: Acero_AppEvidence_v2.pdf (data retention and network topology).

Best,
Jen
Senior Contracts Manager
Acero Health
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Jen Park <jen.park@acerohealth.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 14 Sep 2028 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: availability exhibit + order-form language for MSA/SOW attachments

Hi Jen — thanks, and appreciate the clear ask. Looping in Monica (evidence & compliance), Lauren (legal/order-form phrasing), and Ben (engineering/ops) so we can put together a concise package. Quick answers/next steps below: 

1) SLOs & regional nuance: We can draft an exhibit that supports a global 99.95% availability target with a region-specific appendix (US-east latency SLOs included). If you need per-region credit triggers (e.g., credits only if regional availability < X for Y consecutive days) we can include that in the exhibit.

2) Regional fallback language: We have standard routing/fallback language; Ben will propose a short-handed paragraph that defines "fallback region" and acceptable failover times.

3) Evidence bundle: Monica will attach a minimal evidence bundle (SOC2 scope excerpt, last 6 months uptime summary, and an evidence checklist). We typically avoid including full runbooks in outbound SOW attachments, but we can provide a redacted ops excerpt and a statement of where full runbooks are stored for audit.

4) Order-form exhibit vs. MSA: Lauren will draft the order-form exhibit language (simple exhibit + credit schedule) so Procurement can attach it directly to the order form. We will avoid changing the core MSA unless Acero requests.

Timeline: we'll aim to return a draft exhibit and evidence checklist by EOD Monday (9/17). If Procurement truly needs 9/20, flag that and we will prioritize DocuSign-ready language.

Attachments included with this reply (internal): uptime-evidence-checklist.xlsx (stub).

If you can confirm the definitive latency number(s) and whether credits should be global or regional, we'll bake that into the first draft.

Regards,
Vivek
Head of Enterprise Sales Ops
Redwood Inference
